optimizedDescription.value: Orchestrate implementation review combining Core tracking with Code Graph symbol resolution via single provider lifecycle.

optimizedContext.value:
# Build Implementation Review

## Rules

- `buildImplementationReview(ctx, input)` obtains raw review via `ctx.kernel.changes.getImplementationReview`, opens graph via `withOpenGraphProvider`, gets graph health, resolves symbol links via `ResolveSymbolReference`.
- SDK MUST NOT parse source syntax, reimplement symbol matching, or perform presenter formatting. Core owns stored tracking; Code Graph owns resolution.
- Result retains stored spec, file, symbol values unchanged. Symbol links gain structured resolution projection: `status`, reason, graph `health`/`coverage`, canonical logical `target`, declarations, `candidates`, `provenance`, ordered resolution `path`.
- File-level links remain valid without symbol forcing. MUST NOT mutate active manifests, links, or archived sidecars.
- One health evaluation + batch symbol resolution under one opened-provider lifecycle; MUST NOT re-open provider per link.
- Pass each stored implementation symbol string to provider resolver unchanged (with link file when present). MUST NOT parse owner-qualified syntax, package specifiers, or canonical logical ids; MUST NOT select language adapter. Provider result is review outcome; unresolved/ambiguous stays unresolved/ambiguous.
- Readable non-current/incomplete graph → per-link `unresolved`. Provider init/read failures → standard infrastructure errors, not fake missing links.
- Shared host behavior: CLI `change implementation` and `change status --implementation` consume identical projection; hosts MUST NOT maintain independent fallbacks.

## Constraints

- Returns structured data only.
- Depends on Core and Code Graph through public APIs.
- Resolution diagnostics do not block verification or archive.
